name: io.github.EugeneNeverov/productops-jira
title: ProductOps Jira Sprint Health
description: Read-only Jira sprint health: cycle time, blockers, scope creep and carry-over, with demo data.

environmentVariables.name: PRODUCTOPS_JIRA_MODE
environmentVariables.description: fixtures (default, bundled synthetic demo data) or live (your Jira Cloud via the Atlassian MCP server, run `productops-jira login` first)

environmentVariables.name: PRODUCTOPS_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to productops.config.json (allowed folders, policy, Jira settings)

environmentVariables.name: PRODUCTOPS_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Folder for credentials, cache and audit log (default ~/.productops)

environmentVariables.name: PRODUCTOPS_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log level on stderr: debug, info, warn, error or silent (default info)
